overview: A sandbox-only cross-chain swap simulator that quotes a HoudiniSwap-style route into NAK and walks each order through a simulated deposit, swap and payout.
features: Pick any of 21 cross-chain tokens and get a two-leg quote into NAK
Type your ICP principal as the NAK recipient, with validation
Choose Standard or Private routing with different fees and ETAs
Create an order and simulate sending the deposit
Watch a combined timeline from deposit to NAK delivery
Track any order by ID and see recent orders
Edit token prices, router config and sandbox balances in Test Controls
Reset the sandbox at any time
